units.n: 2. Unit 2 — Depth Study 1 (choose one; British if Period Study is non-British, and vice versa)
subs: The first part of one of the eight depth study options, studied through primary sources
British depth options pair with non-British period studies (and vice versa)

subs: Wales: Resistance, Conquest and Rebellion c.1240–1415

units.n: 4. Unit 4 — Depth Study 2: the second part of the chosen depth study
subs: The later part of the Unit 2 depth study option, studied in greater depth
Examined through interpretations and source evaluation
Investigation of an issue of historical debate through differing interpretations
Use of contemporary and later sources to explain how and why interpretations differ (approx. 4000 words)
